# Waslyy Software Solutions

> Remote-first software development agency that builds custom software, AI agents, websites, mobile apps, and e-commerce platforms for clients worldwide.

## About

Waslyy Software Solutions is a software development team specializing in shipping production-grade products. The team works with founders, growing companies, and enterprises that need reliable engineering partners.

- **Website:** https://www.waslyysolutions.com/
- **Email:** contact@waslyysolutions.com
- **Location:** Global — remote first
- **LinkedIn:** https://www.linkedin.com/company/waslyy-solutions/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/waslyysolutions

## Services

- **Web Development** — High-converting websites and e-commerce stores optimized for speed, SEO, and mobile.
- **Mobile App Development** — Native-feeling iOS and Android experiences, from ride-sharing to social platforms.
- **Custom Software Development** — Tailored business software, internal tools, and SaaS platforms.
- **AI Agents & Automation** — Voice AI agents that handle calls 24/7, plus custom AI automation that integrates with existing systems (CRM, calendars, email).
- **E-Commerce Platforms** — Full storefronts with payments, inventory, and shipping integrations.

## AI Voice Agents

Waslyy builds production AI voice agents that:
- Answer calls 24/7 in natural conversation
- Book appointments and update records
- Send follow-up emails and trigger downstream workflows
- Connect to existing systems (CRMs, calendars, ticketing)
